columns.name: ThreatType
columns.description: WhoisXML API threat type: attack, botnet, c2, malware, phishing, spam, suspicious, tor or generic.

columns.name: FirstSeen
columns.description: Day WhoisXML API first observed the domain.

columns.name: LastSeen
columns.description: Day WhoisXML API last observed the domain, as of FeedDate.

columns.name: ChangeType
columns.description: added, removed, or active (a periodic re-send or first-connect history).

columns.name: FeedDate
columns.description: Date of the WhoisXML API snapshot the row was computed from.

columns.name: FeedVersion
columns.description: Version of that day's file: 1, then 2 and up after a republish.

columns.name: ParentRank
columns.description: Popularity rank of the listing's registered domain, 0 if unranked.

columns.name: IsPublicSuffix
columns.description: True when the listed domain is itself a public suffix, such as mysynology.net, under which unrelated parties hold names.
